claim.value: Ambiguous identifiers may affect record paths.
claim.scope: A possible limitation of the documentary reconstruction; no particular identifier is judged ambiguous.

provenance.rationale: The span explicitly identifies ambiguous identifiers as a possible limitation of record paths.

signal_basis.value: Trace records from purported approval to order placement and attachment, record order identifiers, and assess whether approval records link to the relevant order and precede placement.
signal_basis.scope: Documentary reconstruction of the flagged orders; these checks are proposed observations, without an asserted finding of identifier ambiguity.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans establish record tracing, identifier collection, linkage and timing checks, and their proposed observational status.
This component is inapplicable because the judgment is SUPPORTED.

rationale: The operation depends on matching documentary records to particular orders. Ambiguous identifiers can leave those matches uncertain and thereby affect reconstructed record paths. This licenses the stated possibility without establishing ambiguity in any particular record.
uncertainty: Whether identifiers are actually ambiguous, and how much any ambiguity affects reconstruction, remains unspecified and is outside the claim.
